title: The effective in-flight ceiling is the smaller of `max_in_flight` and what the memory budget affords, and a clamp is logged at boot and by every reload
divergesFromPhp: `pm.max_children` is a free number and the out-of-memory killer enforces its product with memory; here the ceiling is derived from the budget, the configured number is clamped rather than trusted, and the overflow is a `503`
